metadata.title: Configuration
metadata.description: This section allows administrators to define and manage system-wide settings that apply across the entire platform. These global parameters control core functionalities, security policies, performance thresholds, and other critical configurations.

mineru_api_description: When enabled, the system will prioritize using the MinerU API for document parsing to improve parsing quality and speed.
mineru_api_token_tips: Tips: The official MinerU API Token is valid for 14 days, please replace it before it expires.
use_doc_ray_description: When enabled, the system will use doc-ray for document parsing.
use_markitdown_description: When enabled, the system will use markitdown for document parsing.
system_default_quota_description: These default quotas help maintain system stability, prevent resource abuse, and ensure fair allocation across users or applications.
backup_description: Export or import system configuration (Bots, prompts, system settings) for cross-environment migration and disaster recovery.
backup_import_hint: Select a previously exported .json backup file to import.
backup_import_validating_desc: Click Validate to parse and inspect the backup file contents.
backup_import_confirm_desc: Will import the following configuration items. Existing items with the same name will be overwritten.
backup_has_secrets_warning: This backup file contains sensitive fields. Please confirm it is safe.
backup_toast_no_scope: Please select at least one export scope
